# Community templates

Service 18. v1, 21 Oct 2026.

## C1 Community guidelines (client edits and approves, kind `template`)

> **Welcome to {{community_name}}**
>
> This is a place for {{audience}} to help each other, share ideas and talk to the {{brand_name}} team.
>
> 1. Be kind. No insults, harassment or hate.
> 2. Stay on topic: {{topics}}.
> 3. No spam, no selling, no affiliate links unless the team says yes.
> 4. Keep personal data private: yours and other people's.
> 5. Need help with an order or account? Use {{support_contact}}. The team cannot see account details here.
> 6. {{local_rule}}
>
> Our AI assistant, {{bot_name}}, answers simple questions and points you to the right person. It will always say that it is an AI.
>
> Moderators remove posts that break these rules. Repeated breaks lead to removal from the community.

`{{local_rule}}` examples: GCC: "Please respect religion, culture and local laws. No political posts." EU and UK: "We process your posts as described in {{privacy_link}}."

## C2 Welcome message (host agent, sent to each new member)

> Hi {{first_name}}, welcome to {{community_name}}! I am {{bot_name}}, the AI assistant here. 3 good places to start:
> - Say hello in {{intro_channel}} and tell us what you {{use_or_make}}
> - Read this week's topic: {{weekly_topic_link}}
> - Ask anything in {{questions_channel}}; members and the team answer there
>
> For order or account help, use {{support_contact}}.

## C3 Weekly topic prompt

> **This week: {{topic}}**
> {{one_line_why_it_matters}}
> Share {{what_to_share}} below. We will feature the most useful replies in Friday's wins thread (we ask before we feature anyone).

## C4 Wins thread (Friday)

> **Friday wins** 🎉 What went well for you this week with {{product_or_hobby}}? Small wins count.

## C5 Product feedback round (monthly)

> The {{brand_name}} product team is planning {{area}}. 3 quick questions:
> 1. What slows you down most with {{area}}?
> 2. If you could change 1 thing, what would it be?
> 3. Want to join a 20-minute call with the team? React with ✋.
>
> Summary goes to the product team. We will post what they decide.

## C6 Champion invitation

> Hi {{first_name}}, you have helped {{n_members}} members this quarter. Thank you! We would like to invite you to {{champion_programme}}: early access to new features, a direct line to the product team and {{perk}}.
>
> There is nothing you need to post or review in return.

## C7 Escalation handover (host agent to member)

> Thanks, {{first_name}}. This needs a person from our team. I have passed it to {{team_name}}, who usually reply within {{sla}}. You do not need to post it again.
